description: This file defines the ClientObserverPlacementStrategyResolver class, which implements the IPlacementStrategyResolver interface to resolve placement strategies for client observer grains within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: ClientObserverPlacementStrategyResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for resolving placement strategies for client observer grains based on grain type.

methods.name: TryResolvePlacementStrategy
methods.description: Attempts to resolve and assign a placement strategy for a given grain type, returning true if successful.
